readings.commitment: The resignation convention has decayed: ministers who once fell on departmental failure now apologize and remain — Crichel Down's standard cited mainly in its breach
readings.delta: Suppression weakening over time (the sanction increasingly declined); beneficiary is embattled incumbents; victim set is the convention's deterrent force; extractiveness of failure's price renegotiated downward

readings.commitment: Accountability migrated to committees: elected-chair select committees now do the sustained interrogation the chamber's theater cannot — scrutiny rebuilt off the floor
readings.delta: Suppression of evasion by forum redesign; beneficiary is systematic parliamentary scrutiny; victim set is ministers managing set-piece questions only; extractiveness of information by committee subpoena-in-practice

readings.commitment: Next Steps agencies broke the chain: operational matters delegated to chief executives leave ministers answering for policy only — responsibility divided is responsibility diluted
readings.delta: Suppression of the single accountable neck; beneficiary is ministers with an operational shield; victim set is the convention's clarity; extractiveness of blame routed to officials the House cannot remove

readings.commitment: Scotland's settlement reverses the default: everything not reserved is devolved — a drafting choice that built expansive home rule into the statute's silence
readings.delta: Suppression of Westminster's residual claim in the unlisted; beneficiary is Holyrood's competence; victim set is centralist defaults; extractiveness of power flowing to Edinburgh by omission

readings.commitment: Brexit stress-tested Sewel and Sewel bent: consent withheld by devolved legislatures and overridden — 'not normally' revealed as 'not until it matters'
readings.delta: Suppression of the consent convention at the hard case; beneficiary is Westminster's recovered supremacy; victim set is conventional federalism's credibility; extractiveness of devolved consent shown waivable

readings.commitment: Devolution built the exit's anteroom: a national parliament, a referendum precedent, and a standing mandate argument — the settlement that was meant to kill separatism gave it an address
readings.delta: Suppression of independence deferred, not resolved; beneficiary is the constitutional-route independence movement; victim set is unionist finality claims; extractiveness of the question renewable each electoral cycle

readings.commitment: The Union of 1707 incorporated, not federated: one Parliament absorbed two, and Scotland's institutions survived as protected exceptions inside a unitary state
readings.delta: Suppression of the federal alternative at the founding; beneficiary is the unitary Parliament; victim set is Scottish parliamentary continuity; extractiveness of legislative voice merged into the larger chamber

readings.commitment: Some Union articles claim entrenchment: the Kirk and Scots law secured 'in all time coming' — MacCormick's heresy that even Westminster cannot touch the Union's fundamentals
readings.delta: Suppression of supremacy's universality (on this reading); beneficiary is the protected Scottish institutions; victim set is unlimited-sovereignty doctrine; extractiveness of the guarantees held beyond repeal

readings.commitment: The orthodox answer: the Union Acts are statutes like any other, amendable by the Parliament they created — entrenchment-in-1707 cannot bind the sovereign it constituted
readings.delta: Suppression of fundamental-terms doctrine; beneficiary is Diceyan orthodoxy; victim set is entrenchment claims; extractiveness of the guarantees held at Parliament's continuing pleasure

readings.commitment: The 1679 Act's genius was procedure: deadlines, penalties on judges and gaolers, no re-commitment for the same cause — the ancient writ given enforcement mechanics
readings.delta: Suppression of evasion by specified machinery; beneficiary is detainees with enforceable timelines; victim set is dilatory custodians personally fined; extractiveness of detention-by-delay priced per offense

readings.commitment: Habeas lives with its suspensions: wartime and rebellion Acts repeatedly paused it — the liberty defined as much by when Parliament may switch it off as by the writ itself
readings.delta: Suppression of the safeguard by statute in crisis; beneficiary is emergency executive detention; victim set is the detained during suspension windows; extractiveness of liberty conditional on parliamentary forbearance

readings.commitment: The writ's modern tests are at the margins: detention without trial of suspects and deportees, Belmarsh's declaration — the seventeenth-century machinery still the live instrument
readings.delta: Suppression of indefinite executive detention re-litigated each era; beneficiary is the security-detained with counsel; victim set is internment schemes; extractiveness of liberty defended on the old writ's ground

readings.commitment: The right was born refusing a census: the 1983 judgment derived control over one's data from dignity and personality before databases could show what they would become
readings.delta: Suppression of unconsented enumeration; beneficiary is the counted citizen; victim set is total-information state designs; extractiveness of personal data conditioned on purpose and consent

readings.commitment: The judgment seeded a legal order: purpose limitation, minimization, and consent grew from it into German then European data law — a constitutional right that became a regulatory architecture
readings.delta: Suppression of free-floating data processing; beneficiary is data subjects under the GDPR's ancestor; victim set is collection-first business and administration models; extractiveness of the data economy bounded by the doctrine's offspring

readings.commitment: The right is the surveillance state's standing auditor: each retention and screening scheme measured against it, struck or narrowed — Karlsruhe's longest-running engagement
readings.delta: Suppression of bulk-collection programs serially; beneficiary is the unsuspected surveilled; victim set is dragnet security designs; extractiveness of monitoring rationed by judgment after judgment

readings.commitment: Article 14's working test is classification: intelligible differentia, rational nexus to purpose — equality administered as a reasonableness review of line-drawing
readings.delta: Suppression of arbitrary classification; beneficiary is those outside rational lines; victim set is unexplained legislative sorting; extractiveness of burden distribution required to show its logic

readings.commitment: Royappa widened the lens: arbitrariness itself violates equality, classification or none — Article 14 as a general guarantee against caprice in state action
readings.delta: Suppression of arbitrary action beyond classification cases; beneficiary is anyone facing capricious state power; victim set is the old test's limits; extractiveness of discretion disciplined by a broader net

readings.commitment: The code's frontier is private power: clubs, employers, and platforms doing the excluding — how far the equality articles reach past the state is the live boundary question
readings.delta: Suppression of private discrimination contested at the doctrine's edge; beneficiary is claimants against private gatekeepers; victim set is private-autonomy defenses; extractiveness within civil society partially answerable

readings.commitment: Article 32 carries the full arsenal: habeas corpus, mandamus, prohibition, quo warranto, certiorari — the prerogative writs nationalized as fundamental-rights machinery
readings.delta: Suppression of remedy-shopping obstacles; beneficiary is petitioners choosing the fitting writ; victim set is violations between remedies; extractiveness answered by a complete toolkit

readings.commitment: Public interest litigation remade the article: a postcard from prison became a petition, standing relaxed to whoever speaks for the voiceless — the remedy democratized into a movement
readings.delta: Suppression of standing as a gate; beneficiary is the unrepresented poor via proxies; victim set is adversarial-form purism; extractiveness of suffering reachable without a paying client

readings.commitment: PIL's critics count the costs: judicial administration of forests, buses, and budgets — the heart-and-soul remedy grown into a parallel government by decree
readings.delta: Suppression of executive discretion by continuing mandamus; beneficiary is court-supervised governance; victim set is separation-of-powers lines; extractiveness of policy relocated to the bench's docket

readings.commitment: The Ninth Schedule was the First Amendment's invention: a constitutional vault where statutes hide from rights review — land reform first, then whatever later parliaments deposited
readings.delta: Suppression of judicial review by enumeration; beneficiary is deposited legislation; victim set is rights claims against vault contents; extractiveness of immunity expanding until Coelho re-opened the vault

readings.commitment: The First Amendment widened speech's exceptions: public order and friendly relations added to Article 19(2) to overturn early acquittals — free speech narrowed by its first constitutional correction
readings.delta: Suppression of speech enlarged by amendment; beneficiary is public-order prosecution; victim set is the early broad-speech precedents; extractiveness of expression conditioned on grounds the founders had rejected

readings.commitment: The same generation wrote and rewrote: Nehru's government amending Ambedkar's text within months — proof the founding was a process, and precedent for treating the text as workable, not sacred
readings.delta: Suppression of original-text sanctity at the start; beneficiary is adaptive constitutionalism; victim set is strong originalism's premise; extractiveness of the founding's authority spread across its revisions

readings.commitment: Article 17 binds neighbors, not just the state: untouchability forbidden in any form by anyone — one of the constitution's rare directly horizontal commands
readings.delta: Suppression of private enforcement of caste; beneficiary is Dalits against social sanction; victim set is community enforcers; extractiveness of exclusion actionable without state action

readings.commitment: The article outran its enforcement: the Civil Rights and Atrocities Acts brought low conviction rates and routine intimidation — abolition on paper measured against practice in the village
readings.delta: Suppression incomplete at the point of delivery; beneficiary is formal equality's record; victim set is victims facing hostile local machinery; extractiveness of caste persisting in enforcement's shadow

readings.commitment: Untouchability survives as occupation: manual scavenging and segregated labor persist statutes later — the practice abolished by name continuing by economic structure
readings.delta: Suppression of the named practice, persistence of its economy; beneficiary is the formal prohibition's scope; victim set is those the labor market still sorts by caste; extractiveness continuing through structure law has not reached

readings.commitment: The Tables' victory was publication itself: law posted where the plebs could read it ended the pontiffs' monopoly on knowing what the law was
readings.delta: Suppression of legal knowledge as class property; beneficiary is the litigant who can now read; victim set is priestly interpretive monopoly; extractiveness of adjudication by secret rule ended

readings.commitment: What they published was harsh: debt bondage, the creditor's knife, intermarriage banned between the orders — codification fixed the existing order's terms, including its cruelties
readings.delta: Suppression of ambiguity, not of severity; beneficiary is certainty including the creditor's; victim set is debtors under now-explicit nexum; extractiveness written plainly rather than reduced

readings.commitment: The Tables became Rome's legal founding myth: schoolboys recited them centuries after their rules were dead — the code as ancestor cult more than working law
readings.delta: Suppression of later doubt by canonical status; beneficiary is the legal tradition's continuity story; victim set is historical accuracy about early law; extractiveness of authority drawn from a half-remembered text

readings.commitment: The graphe paranomon let democracy bind itself: the assembly's own decrees challengeable as unlawful, with the proposer answering — collective sovereignty given an internal brake
readings.delta: Suppression of decree-by-momentum; beneficiary is second-thought governance; victim set is unreviewable assembly action; extractiveness of haste chargeable to its author

readings.commitment: The action priced political initiative: every proposal carried personal liability, so the rostrum belonged to those who could afford the risk — a deterrent that selected as it disciplined
readings.delta: Suppression of proposal-making by the risk-averse; beneficiary is wealthy and confident orators; victim set is initiative from the cautious; extractiveness of political voice carrying a personal bond

readings.commitment: The action became a duelist's tool: rival orators indicting each other's decrees as moves in a longer feud — judicial review as the continuation of assembly politics
readings.delta: Suppression deployed tactically rather than juridically; beneficiary is whichever faction prosecutes best; victim set is the device's neutrality; extractiveness of litigation as politics by other means

readings.commitment: The ekklesia was self-rule without remainder: war, peace, food, and death decided by the present demos — no government existed apart from the governed assembled
readings.delta: Suppression of the ruler-ruled distinction itself; beneficiary is the attending citizen as sovereign; victim set is delegated authority of every kind; extractiveness of decision held by the room

readings.commitment: Mytilene showed the cost: a massacre voted, repented, and reversed by a day — assembly sovereignty as government by the speed of regret
readings.delta: Suppression of deliberative distance; beneficiary is whoever speaks last and best; victim set is decisions needing a cooler hour; extractiveness of irreversible acts gambled on the second ship

readings.commitment: The fourth century added a filter: laws distinguished from decrees and routed through nomothetai panels — the radical assembly retrofitted with legislative procedure
readings.delta: Suppression of decree-rule over standing law; beneficiary is legal stability; victim set is fifth-century-style assembly omnipotence; extractiveness of lawmaking slowed through the panel

readings.commitment: The final decree was emergency without the dictatorship's safeguards: no term, no named task, no office — only an exhortation under which consuls killed citizens
readings.delta: Suppression of the bounded-emergency form by a boundless one; beneficiary is the decreeing majority; victim set is the targets denied trial; extractiveness of the exception freed from its own rules

readings.commitment: The decree was born killing reformers: first used against Gaius Gracchus, its precedents are the corpses of the Republic's own tribunes — crisis machinery as factional weapon from its first day
readings.delta: Suppression of popular reform under emergency color; beneficiary is the senatorial order threatened by reform; victim set is the Gracchans and their successors; extractiveness of politics conducted by proscription

readings.commitment: Its legality was argued at the time: Cicero executed citizens under it and was exiled for exactly that — the Republic never agreed on whether its emergency was lawful
readings.delta: Suppression contested in the Republic's own courts; beneficiary alternated with the political wind; victim set included the decree's executors; extractiveness of emergency power litigated by exile and recall
